topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: Found these here flowers, didn't I? No note, no mark to tell who sent 'em. Got me thinking, surely. 'Tis a puzzle, like tryin' to guess which field might flood with the next heavy rain. I’ve walked around this, turnin' it over as many times as I've turned soil, and still, the earth don't give up its secrets that easy. Must be someone wishin' well, but why hide behind whispers and shadows? I ought to ask the Lord to send a sign, clear as the first shoots in spring, so I might know. Til then, I'll just tend to my work, and let the mystery bloom or wither as it will.
